account_deletion_meta_description: How to delete your account in the eDoctor app, what is deleted at once and what we keep, why and for how long.
account_deletion_intro: You may delete your account in the eDoctor app at any time: from the app itself or by a request to support.
account_deletion_final_body: the account cannot be restored and you cannot sign in to it again.
account_deletion_app_step_open: Open the eDoctor app and sign in to your account.
account_deletion_app_step_path: Tap Profile → Account settings → Delete account.
account_deletion_app_step_review: Review what will be deleted and what will be kept, then tap "Send the code".
account_deletion_app_step_code: Enter the 6-digit code we send to the email or mobile of the account and tap "Delete permanently".
account_deletion_app_result: The account is deleted at once and signed out on every device. Whatever happens in the background (for example removing the appointments from a doctor's calendar) is completed within one month at the latest.
account_deletion_support_body: If you cannot use the app, email eDoctor support at:
account_deletion_support_include: Say in your message that you are asking for your account to be deleted, and give the email or mobile you sign in with.
account_deletion_support_verify: Before the deletion we will confirm that the request comes from you.
account_deletion_support_deadline: We will answer your request within one month at the latest.
account_deletion_removed_body: Your sign-in details (email, mobile, password, Google sign-in), your profile (name, date of birth, photo), your AMKA and tax number (AFM), the family members you added, your questions and reviews, the notifications not yet sent and your cookie choices. Your future appointments are cancelled.
account_deletion_removed_doctor: If you are a doctor, your public profile, your offices, schedules and services and the customer and item lists of your till are deleted too, and your calendar is disconnected.
account_deletion_retained_title: What we keep, why and for how long
account_deletion_retained_intro: Some data cannot be deleted at once, because the law obliges the doctor or us to keep it for a set time. We keep it locked, only for that purpose, and delete or anonymise it automatically as soon as that time ends.
account_deletion_retained_patient_record: The doctor's record of your appointments

Your details as recorded in each appointment (name, phone, email, AMKA, AFM, notes) stay visible only to the doctor you visited, because the law obliges the doctor to keep patient records (Law 3418/2005, Article 14).

Duration: 10 years from your last visit to that doctor. Then your details are deleted and only the date, the office, the services, the status and the amount of the appointment remain, with nothing that identifies you.
account_deletion_retained_appointment_bo: If you are a doctor: your appointment book
Your appointment book is locked: each patient sees only their own appointments, nobody else sees it, and a copy is given only if you or a competent authority asks for it.
Duration: 10 years from each patient's last visit, then it is anonymised like the doctor's record above.
account_deletion_retained_tax_records_ti: If you are a doctor: your receipts
account_deletion_retained_tax_records_bo: The receipts you issued, their transmission to the tax authority (AADE) and their issuer details are kept for as long as tax law requires.
account_deletion_retained_tax_records_du: Duration: until 31 December of the sixth year after the year of issue; then they are deleted.
account_deletion_retained_accounting_tit: The platform's accounting for a doctor
account_deletion_retained_accounting_bod: SMS movements and packages and licences are kept for our own tax obligations.
account_deletion_retained_accounting_dur: Duration: up to 5 years after the end of the year they concern; then they are deleted.
account_deletion_retained_archive_body: We keep the proof that you accepted the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy, the trace of the deletion itself and our decisions on reviews we moderated, so that we can prove we complied with the law. Only an authorised administrator can access this archive, and every access is recorded.
account_deletion_retained_archive_durati: Duration: 5 years from the deletion, and it is then deleted. If the account had been blocked for abuse, the block is kept for as long as it lasts and for 5 years at most.
account_deletion_retained_archive_messag: Message reports (who reported whom, the reason and our decision), without the text of the message, are kept for 3 years from the deletion and then deleted.
account_deletion_retained_private: None of the data we keep is shown publicly or used for any other purpose.
account_deletion_record_copy: If you are a doctor, you can ask support ({email}) for a copy of your appointment book and your receipts, before or after the deletion.

consent_body_lead: We use tools and other technologies to keep the website working, to remember your preferences and to improve your experience. Some tools are required for the website to function and cannot be switched off. If you accept them, you agree to the
consent_body_tail: . You can change your preferences at any time from your profile.
consent_tools_intro: You can choose which tools you allow. The strictly necessary ones are always on; the others stay off until you turn them on.
consent_category_essential_body: These tools are required for the website to work and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only activated in response to something you do, such as signing in, setting your privacy preferences or filling in a form.
consent_category_functional_body: These tools add functionality and personalisation, such as video or live chat. They may be set by us or by providers whose services we have added. If you do not allow them, some features may not work properly.
consent_category_analytics_body: These tools help us understand how the website is used so we can improve it. The information is collected in aggregate and does not identify you directly.
consent_category_marketing_body: These tools are used to show you more relevant offers and to measure how our campaigns perform. They may be set by our advertising partners.
